items.title: En Grèce, des jeunes diplômés désormais plus nombreux à rentrer au pays qu'à s'expatrier
items.summary: Y a-t-il un retour des cerveaux en Grèce ? Pendant les années noires de la crise économique, entre 2009 et 2018, les jeunes Grecs ont émigré en masse dans d’autres pays de l’UE, aux États-Unis et au Canada principalement. Maintenant, ils reviennent petit à petit en Grèce. Un récent rapport de l’OCDE montre que les tendances migratoires se sont inversées depuis 2023 : ils sont désormais plus nombreux à rentrer au pays qu’à s’exiler. Le signe d’une économie plus dynamique, même si ce n’est pas le seul facteur qui entre en jeu pour pousser les jeunes expats à revenir.

These phenomena give rise to structures ranging from very small to large, which significantly influence the overall motion and energy flow of the plasma.

items.title: [Perspectives] Beyond the battlefield: war and global health security
items.summary: During the Syrian war (2011–24), the Assad Government forces and their Russian allies conducted hundreds of strikes on medical facilities in opposition-held areas. Monitoring groups documented over 600 attacks on health care, resulting in the deaths of hundreds of health-care workers throughout the conflict. Hospitals in eastern Aleppo and other contested regions were reduced to rubble. Surgeons operated in underground rooms illuminated by generators, and ambulances were targeted while transporting patients between sites.

items.title: [Perspectives] Temporal rationing: a man with gastric cancer in Colombia
items.summary: Pepe, a 45-year-old man living in the city of Cali, Colombia, worked as a self-employed hauler of goods with a wheelbarrow. In 2010, he presented to a general practitioner with several months of abdominal heaviness and non-exertional substernal burning. The physician provisionally diagnosed gastro-oesophageal reflux disease and prescribed omeprazole. However, Pepe's symptoms slowly worsened and 10 weeks later he returned to the physician, who ordered a gastroscopy, which occurred 2 months later, revealing an ulcerated mass.
